messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: The cost of tirzepatide depends on your insurance plan, pharmacy, and the brand you use.
Zepbound cost
Zepbound may cost $25 for a 1-month or 3-month pen prescription.
This pricing applies if you have commercial insurance and are eligible for the Savings Card.
Note that patients with government insurance (Medicare, Medicaid) are not eligible for the savings card.
Through the Zepbound self-pay program, tirzepatide is available directly to patients.
Tirzepatide is available as a 4-count single-dose vial.
Tirzepatide is available as a single-patient-use KwikPen.
All six doses are available.
The 2.5 mg dose costs $299 per month.
The 5 mg dose costs $399 per month.
The 7.5 mg dose costs $499 per month.
The 10 mg dose costs $699 per month.
The 12.5 mg dose costs $699 per month.
The 15 mg dose costs $699 per month.
The list price of Zepbound is $499–$1,086.37 per fill.
This is not what most people pay.
Refer to our Zepbound price guide for more information, or see " How much is Zepbound with or without insurance? "
and " What is the Zepbound Coupon or Savings Card? "
Mounjaro cost
Triples: [["tirzepatide", "cost depends on", "insurance plan"], ["tirzepatide", "cost depends on", "pharmacy"], ["tirzepatide", "cost depends on", "brand used"], ["zepbound", "cost", "$25 for 1-month or 3-month pen prescription"], ["zepbound", "cost applies to", "commercial insurance"], ["zepbound", "cost applies to", "eligible for Savings Card"], ["zepbound", "not eligible for savings card", "government insurance"], ["zepbound", "self pay program available for", "tirzepatide"], ["tirzepatide", "available as", "4-count single-dose vial"], ["tirzepatide", "available as", "single-patient-use KwikPen"], ["tirzepatide", "has dose availability", "all six doses"], ["tirzepatide", "has dose cost", "$299 per month for 2.5 mg"], ["tirzepatide", "has dose cost", "$399 per month for 5 mg"], ["tirzepatide", "has dose cost", "$499 per month for 7.5 mg"], ["tirzepatide", "has dose cost", "$699 per month for 10 mg"], ["tirzepatide", "has dose cost", "$699 per month for 12.5 mg"], ["tirzepatide", "has dose cost", "$699 per month for 15 mg"], ["zepbound", "has list price", "$499–$1,086.37 per fill"], ["zepbound", "has note", "not what most people pay"], ["zepbound", "has price guide", "refer to Zepbound price guide"], ["zepbound", "has related section", "How much is Zepbound with or without insurance?"], ["zepbound", "has related section", "What is the Zepbound Coupon or Savings Card?"], ["mounjaro", "cost", "not specified in text"]]
Relations: ["available as", "cost", "cost applies to", "cost depends on", "has dose availability", "has dose cost", "has list price", "has note", "has price guide", "has related section", "not eligible for savings card", "self pay program available for"]
Answer:

completion:
available as: The subject drug is available in the dosage form or format specified by the object entity.  
cost: The subject drug has a specific price or cost as described by the object entity.  
cost applies to: The cost described for the subject drug is applicable to the entity specified by the object.  
cost depends on: The cost of the subject drug is influenced by the factors specified by the object entity.  
has dose availability: The subject drug has the availability of the specific dose or doses described by the object entity.  
has dose cost: The subject drug has a specific cost for the dose described by the object entity.  
has list price: The subject drug has a listed price range as specified by the object entity.  
has note: The subject drug has an additional note or comment described by the object entity.  
has price guide: The subject drug has a reference or guide for pricing as specified by the object entity.  
has related section: The subject drug has related information or sections as described by the object entity.  
not eligible for savings card: Patients with the specified entity are not eligible for the savings card associated with the subject drug.  
self pay program available for: The subject drug is available through a self-pay program for the entity specified by the object.
